origins.section: A Constant in the Objective Shrinks the Relative Gap Without Improving the Plan
Plans Within the Gap Can Pick Different Projects
The Forecast's Error Is Larger Than the Gap

recorded.prompt:q-money: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-money: It does change the relative gap, because the gap is divided by the incumbent, and the incumbent now includes $`K`$ ... With a $2B constant the solver divides by about $2.22B instead of $224M, so 0.01% of what it sees is ten times as much money
recorded.prompt:q-project: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-project: funding P077 is proved better only when the forced-in run's incumbent is above the forced-out run's bound, since then some plan with P077 beats every plan without it.
recorded.prompt:q-data: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-data: the last 0.01% of optimality is smaller than what the data can support. ... A gap well below the data's error is enough, and the time saved is better spent on the forecast

recorded.prompt:q-money:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-money:a: "relative gap seen = (bound - incumbent) / (incumbent + K)". The constant is in the denominator, not only the $30M.
recorded.prompt:q-money:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-money:b: "The default run proved only that its plan was within $22k of the best"; "'optimal' from a solver is optimal within the tolerances it ran with"
recorded.prompt:q-money:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-money:c: "The gap is measured on the objective." The objective here includes the $3B constant.
recorded.prompt:q-project:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-project:b: "the gap guarantees the plan's value, not its list of projects."
recorded.prompt:q-project:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-project:c: "'P077 is in the optimal plan' is a stronger claim than any run within a tolerance proves."
recorded.prompt:q-project:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-project:d: "the gap guarantees the plan's value, not its list of projects". The second-best plan "swaps two projects ... ($116k ...) for one other (P218, $113k)", so dropping a project can cost far less than its own NPV.
recorded.prompt:q-data:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-data:a: "Spending eight times the nodes to close a $22k gap buys less than a better forecast would."
recorded.prompt:q-data:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-data:c: "Add a time limit as a safety net ..., and treat a run that stops on it as unsettled". The time limit is a safety net, not a replacement for the gap.
recorded.prompt:q-data:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-data:d: Measured output: GridCap large (10,000 projects) stopped "at a gap of $265k (0.0044%)" after 1 node, below the medium model's 0.0098%. Also: "A gap well below the data's error is enough", whatever the run's size.
